title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
steps:
Boil the pasta,
drain it,
keep the pot

Butter + garlic 30 sec,
then shrimp 3-4 min
until pink

Spinach + pasta in,
squeeze the lemon,
stir until it wilts
vo: Garlic butter shrimp pasta in under thirty minutes.
You need spaghetti, shrimp, butter, garlic, a lemon and baby spinach.
Boil the pasta, drain it, and keep the pot.
Melt the butter, cook the garlic thirty seconds, then the shrimp three to four minutes until pink.
Toss in the spinach and pasta, squeeze the lemon over, and stir until the spinach wilts.
